definitions.explanation: Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.

examples.japanese: {効率的|こうりつてき}な⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to work in an efficient manner.
